title: Theater Transition Stagecraft and Stop Motion Terms
blurb: Ask a video model to get from one room to another and it dissolves. A stage has to do the same job in front of a live audience and it never gets to cut. So I gave the agent a stagecraft manual instead of a prompt guide, plus the stop-motion terms it needs to write FLF2VA prompts: fly systems, trap rooms, wagons, micro-prop animation, persists_50. It read six Lori Nix dioramas itself and wrote all twelve prompts.

thumb.alt: A miniature laundromat at night, its wall of washing machines tilted over at an angle halfway through being stood up into place
